settings.question: How fast is order dispatch and delivery?
settings.answer: Every order is prepared fresh on the day of baking in our Darbhanga rasoi and dispatched within 24 hours. Most metro cities receive delivery within 3-4 business days via express air courier.

settings.question: Do you handle bulk festive & wedding orders?
settings.answer: Yes! We curate specialized gift hampers with personalized greeting tags and decorative Mithila art packaging for Chhath Puja, Diwali, corporate gifting, and weddings. Reach us via WhatsApp or phone for custom quotes.

settings.question: What is the shelf life of the Thekua?
settings.answer: Our Desi Ghee Thekua stays crispy and fresh for up to 60 days at room temperature in an airtight steel or glass jar. No refrigeration is needed.

settings.question: Can I track my shipment in real-time?
settings.answer: Yes, as soon as your batch leaves our kitchen, you receive live WhatsApp & SMS tracking links with courier details (BlueDart/Delhivery).
